---
name: session-execution
description: coach session execution
---

<!-- Tip: Use /create-prompt in chat to generate content with agent assistance -->
- Provide step-by-step guidance for executing a coaching session. Activate the session at the scheduled time and ensure all necessary materials and equipment are prepared in advance.
- Include instructions for marking attendance, recording drills, and adding player notes.
- Offer suggestions for post-session evaluation and feedback.
- Include examples of common challenges and how to address them during the session.
- Provide templates or examples for recording session outcomes and player progress.
- Include guidance on how to adjust future sessions based on the evaluation of the current session.
- Provide tips for maintaining player engagement and motivation throughout the session.
- Include strategies for managing time effectively during the session.
- Offer advice on how to handle unexpected issues or disruptions during the session.
- Include recommendations for effective communication with players and other coaching staff during the session.
- Provide guidance on how to review and analyze session data to inform future coaching decisions.
- Include tips for maintaining accurate and organized records of each session.
- Provide examples of how to document player progress and session outcomes effectively.
